pictures.name: CGR1-Road-Bethlehem
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A dusty road through the hills of Judea at late afternoon, crowds of travelers with bundles and donkeys heading toward the hilltop town of Bethlehem. In the middle, Mary, a young woman of about sixteen with dark hair under a soft blue veil, heavily pregnant, rides a small grey donkey, one hand on her belly, tired but steady, while Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a dusty brown tunic and travel cloak, walks beside her leading the donkey, looking up at her with care. Warm gold light, long deep blue shadows. Weariness, love, journey. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGR2-No-Room
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The lower room of a crowded stone family house in Bethlehem at night, where the animals are kept: an ox and a donkey, straw on the floor, a stone feeding trough filled with hay. In the middle, Mary, a young woman of about sixteen with dark hair under a soft blue veil, heavily pregnant, now resting, gently lays a newborn baby wrapped snugly in plain cream cloth, turned away from the viewer, his face hidden in the folds of the cloth and never visible, a soft glow of light around him, in the manger, while Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a dusty brown tunic and travel cloak, kneels beside her holding a small oil lamp. Above, through an opening, the full upper room with sleeping relatives. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue night. Tenderness, humility, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGR3-Greccio-Cave
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A rocky wooded hillside cave above the small Italian town of Greccio on a winter evening in 1223, a few snowflakes. In the middle, Saint Francis of Assisi, a thin man of about forty with short dark hair and a thin beard, in a rough grey-brown hooded tunic tied with a knotted rope, barefoot, smiling, guides a farmer leading a brown ox and a grey donkey into the cave, where an empty wooden manger full of hay waits. A friend in a noble’s cloak carries an armful of hay. Deep blue twilight, gold lantern light. Simplicity, joy. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGR4-Torches-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The wooded hillside of Greccio at night, Christmas 1223: a long line of villagers, men and women, climbs the snowy path carrying candles and torches toward the glowing cave, singing, a few children walking safely beside them holding their parents’ free hands, no flame near any child, friars in grey-brown tunics among them. In the middle distance, the cave mouth lit warm gold, the ox and donkey visible by the empty manger. Deep blue night, many small gold flames. Joy, wonder, pilgrimage. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CGR5-Francis-Preaches
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside the candlelit cave at Greccio on Christmas night, 1223. In the middle, Saint Francis of Assisi, a thin man of about forty with short dark hair and a thin beard, in a rough grey-brown hooded tunic tied with a knotted rope, barefoot, stands beside the empty wooden manger of hay, wearing a deacon’s white stole over his rough tunic, his hands open, speaking with tears of tenderness on his face. Around him kneel villagers and friars, faces lit gold; the ox and the donkey breathe warm air beside the manger. Warm gold candlelight, deep blue shadows. Tenderness, love, awe. pictures.name: CGR6-Today-Creche
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern family living room at Christmas, painted in the same sacred oil style: a small wooden crib scene on a low table with figures of Mary, Joseph, an ox, a donkey and shepherds around an empty manger. A young father and his small daughter kneel together placing a little wooden donkey; a grandmother watches from an armchair; a decorated tree glows behind. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue snowy window. The crib in the middle. Tenderness, family, wonder. No text, no letters, no logos.
